sloka: तद्विकीर्णं गिरेः शृङ्गं दृष्ट्वा हरिचमूपतिः ।कालाग्निरिव जज्वाल क्रोधोन परवीरहा ।। ६.५९.७६ ।।।।
transliteration: tadvikīrṇaṁ gireḥ śṛṅgaṁ dṛṣṭvā haricamūpatiḥ ।kālāgniriva jajvāla krodhona paravīrahā ।। 6.59.76 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, endowed with extraordinary energy attacked that peak hurled by Neela with seven sharp arrows and it fell broken into pieces.
